description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.
Ruth sends an email to Dev Sandhu and Nina Achebe explaining the deposit deadline and proposing each household pays their £200 share directly to Marian Prowse by end of Wednesday.
The email from Ruth arrives in Dev Sandhu's inbox.
Ruth checks her email inbox and sees no new replies from Dev Sandhu or Nina Achebe.
Nina Achebe checks her email and sees Ruth's email about the deposit deadline.

Nina sends an email to Ruth Kelleher with the text: 'Hi Ruth, thanks for the heads-up. I'm aware of the deposit deadline but still unsure about October due to family stuff. I'll let you know as soon as I can confirm. Nina'
Nina's email arrives in Ruth Kelleher's inbox.
Ruth opens Nina's email and reads it.

Ruth sends a text message to Dev Sandhu and Nina Achebe: 'Hi both, I haven't heard back from you about the deposit. The deadline is tomorrow. I need to know by end of today if you're in or not, otherwise I'll have to tell Marian we're not taking the cottage.'
The text message from Ruth arrives on Dev Sandhu's phone.
Dev Sandhu's phone buzzes with the incoming text from Ruth, but he is in the middle of a task and doesn't look at it right away.
Dev Sandhu continues with his task and does not check the text.
The text message from Ruth arrives on Nina Achebe's phone.
Ruth checks her phone and sees no new text replies from Dev Sandhu or Nina Achebe.
Ruth calls Marian Prowse and tells her they are not taking Cove Cottage for October half-term, thanking her for holding it.
Ruth's phone shows a notification for Nina's email, but she is still on the phone with Marian and does not look at it.
Dev Sandhu finishes his task and picks up his phone, noticing the text message from Ruth that arrived yesterday evening.

Dev sends his reply text to Ruth: 'Hey Ruth, sorry for the late reply, I've been swamped. I really want to go but I'm skint right now after the clutch repair. I can pay my share after I get paid on the 28th. If that's not possible, I understand and I'll have to drop out. Let me know.'
Dev's reply text arrives on Ruth Kelleher's phone.
Marian Prowse checks her phone and sees a missed call from Ruth Kelleher and a voicemail from earlier today.
Marian Prowse listens to Ruth Kelleher's voicemail, learning that the group is not taking Cove Cottage for October half-term.
Marian Prowse listens to the voicemail from Ruth Kelleher.
Marian Prowse finishes listening to the voicemail and closes her phone. She looks at her paper diary and notes that the October half-term week is now available.
Dev's text message is sent from his phone to Ruth Kelleher's phone.
Dev's text message arrives on Ruth Kelleher's phone, showing a notification.
Ruth Kelleher picks up her phone and sees the notification for Dev's text message and the earlier notification for Nina's email.
